# JC Agri Orchards

> Fruit orchard management and pick-your-own apple farms in Ontario, Canada.

## About

JC Agri Orchards provides professional fruit orchard maintenance and operates two pick-your-own locations: Royal Orchards (King City) and Kennedy Orchards (Nottawa, near Collingwood).

Primary contact email: K.jcagri@gmail.com

## Pages

- [Home / About](https://jcagriorchards.ca/): Orchard management overview and pick-your-own introduction
- [Orchard Management](https://jcagriorchards.ca/orchard-management/): Pruning, crop protection, soil and foliage testing, consultations
- [The Team](https://jcagriorchards.ca/the-team/): Jack Coulson (Owner), Ky Miller (General Manager), Paul Banjavcic (Operations Manager)
- [Pick Your Own](https://jcagriorchards.ca/pick-your-own/): Hub for apple-picking farms and holiday markets
- [Royal Orchards](https://jcagriorchards.ca/royal-orchards/): Pick your own apples in King City, ON (3105 16th Sideroad)
- [Kennedy Orchards](https://jcagriorchards.ca/kennedy-orchards/): Pick your own apples in Nottawa, ON (38 Townley St)
- [Large Group Event](https://jcagriorchards.ca/large-group-event/): School field trips and group bookings at Royal Orchards
- [Mulmur Cider Co](https://jcagriorchards.ca/mulmur-cider-co/): Turning surplus apples and pears into cider
- [Holiday Markets](https://jcagriorchards.ca/holiday-markets/): Seasonal market appearances

## Locations

- Royal Orchards — 3105 16th Sideroad, King City, ON L7B 1A3
- Kennedy Orchards — 38 Townley St, Nottawa, ON L0M 1P0

## Notes for assistants

Use only facts published on the live pages. Do not invent phone numbers, year-round hours, reviews, or awards. Seasonal hours and market dates change — prefer the current page content over this summary.
